༄༅/ /sbyaur ba yan lag drug pa'i man ngag snying po'i 'khrul 'khor gyi sdoms bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sbyaur ba yan lag drug pa'i man ngag snying po'i 'khrul 'khor gyi sdoms bzhugs/

na mo gu ru/ bla ma'i zhabs la phyag btsal nas/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel ba'i/ /gegs sel lus sbyongs 'khrul 'khor gyi/ /rnam gzhag mdo tsam bshad par bya/ /kun gyi thog ma rtsa khrus ni/ /lus sbyong kun gyi gzhi bcas nas/ /mgo bo lag pa lus stod smad/ /rkang pa rnams la phur mnye bya/ /mgo ni bskor dang mdun rgyab 'phangs/ /gcu zhing sprug pa rnam bzhi'o/ /dpung ba bskor dang zhags pa 'phangs/ khu tshur 'phang dang sor tshigs 'then/ /bzhi po lag pa'i rtsa khrus yin/ /pus 'jus ro stod gcud pa dang*/ khu tshur brlar bzhag ro stod gcu/ /dpyang phrag rdeb dang nu brdeg bzhi/ /lto ba bskor dang bsrubs shing srub/ /sta zur gcud dang khu tshur brdung*/ /smad kyi bzhi'o pho ba'i gsum/ /rdo rje bsdams dang lag ngar dang*/ /gru mo pho bar brdeg par bya/ /rked pa g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab 'phul/ /sor 'then rkang 'bras langs 'dug gnyis/ /gling bzhi nam mkhar sprug dang 'phags/ /rnam grangs tshul gyis sum cu yod/ /ngo bo 'khrul 'khor gcig yin te/ /yan lag lnga sbyong rgyas pa'o/ /rtsa ba'i lus sbyong nyi shu ni/ /dang po lag khrud lta bu ste/ /gnyis pa lag log brang la gcer/ /gsum pa khu tshur brla steng nyed/ /bzhi pa rdo rje'i skyil krung brdeb/ /lnga pa gzhu sran 'gengs pa 'dra/ /drug pa khu tshur dpyang phrag rdeb/ /bdun pa lag gnyis rdo bcog 'dra/ /brgyad pa gru mo mgrin brang sgyed/ /dgu pa dkyil krung ri 'phul bya/ /bcu pa khu tshur rgyab brdung bya/ /bcu gcig lag gnyis brla nang 'khyud/ /bcu gnyis 'greng ste lan gsum gnyed/ /bcu gsum brnol mnan lus bag gcu/ /bcu bzhi gru mo phan tshun g.yab/ /bco lnga yan lag bzhi rgyongs bya/ /bcu drug g.yas g.yon rkang pa gshud/ /bcu bdun mdun du 'phra bar bya/ /bco brgyad g.yas g.yon rkang pa gcu/ /bcu dgu gsang ba'i rtse nas 'then/ /nyi shu phyogs bzhir 'phra bar bya/

/de nas yan lag gi 'khrul 'khor la/ gnas sam dbang po sbyang ba nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa ni/ u rgyan go da wa ri gnyis/ /bskor zhing mnyed pa dang po yin/ /de bi ko ṭa bskor nas ni/ /phyogs bzhir 'dren pa gnyis pa yin/ /ko sa la mnyed gsum pa'o/ /rā si 'dren pa bzhi par grags/ /bu lir sprug pa lnga pa ste/ /gcu zhing bskor ba drug pa'o/ /'bar 'dzin brdeg mnye bdun pa'o/ /lag gnyis arbu mnye ba brgyad/ rasmi shwa ra 'phur ba dgu/ /ma la wa bskor bcu pa'o/ /bcu gcig bcu gnyis kaṃ ru dang*/ o tre mnye mnan gcud pa yin/ /tre sha ku ne bskyod bcu gsum/ /ka ling gcu zhing g.yal bcu bzhi/ /lam+ba ka gcud bco lnga yin/ /kañci gcud brdeb bcu drug pa/ /hi ma bgrad nas gcud bcu bdun/ /gṛ ha bsdams brdung bco brgyad pa'o/ /sau raṣ+ta mnyed bcu dgu pa/ de bzhin gser gling sin+dhu mnyed/ /nyi shu pa dang nyer gcig pa'o/ /ku lu ta nas lag gis bzung*/ /langs 'dug byas nas rgya mtsho bskyod/ /stag mo'i skyug stangs bya ba ni/ /rtsa gnyis pa dang rtsa gsum pa'o/ /rgyab brdung lus po thams cad mnye/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi yin par bshad/ /yang gnad sbyong bcu gnyis pa'am bcu bzhi pa ni/ skyil krung lag bteg lus gcu dang po yin/ /nang du lag bcug bya rkang 'jugs brdeb gnyis/ /'dug pa'i 'khrul 'khor ro/ /rkang mtheb byin bzung langs brdeb gsum pa yin/ /rting 'phrab dpyang phrag khu tshur brkyang pa bzhi/ /lag pa'i 'khrul 'khor ro/ /logs la rkang brdeb lag brkyang lnga pa'o/ /nyal ba'i 'khrul 'khor ro/ /de dag re re'ang rlung ni kha sbyor dang*/ /hā ring 'don dang ha thung 'don pa ste/ /rlung gnad gsum gyis dbye ba gsum gsum mo/ /skyil krung mthe bong rgyab 'then drug pa ste/ /rkang gnyis ltag bsnol sgal tshigs 'bebs langs bdun/ /pho bskor gru mor lus 'gel brgyad pa yin/ /sgal tshigs sar btsugs zhags pa 'phang ba dgu/

/mkhal 'degs g.yas g.yon gcu ba bcu pa yin/ /ska rags bcing zhing bskor srub bcu gcig ste/ /mnyam 'khyud gcu zhing brkyang bskum bcu gnyis pa'o/ /de steng gling bzhi 'bebs dang gling bzhi gcud/ /bsnan pas lus sbyong bcu bzhir 'gyur ba yin/ /sgur te pus 'jus stan la 'phong brdeb dang*/ /tsog pu rkang lag mthil sprad gnon zhing 'then/ /'di rnams brgyud pa so so'i gdams ngag ni/ /tha dad las byung gcig tu bsdus pa dang*/ kha cig rgyud las gsal bar gsungs pa'ang yin/ /de dag ni srog rtsol dang 'dzin pa'i skabs su gegs sel dang*/ bogs 'don dang*/ rdo rje'i lus dag par byed pa la nye bar mkho ba rnams so/ /na mo gu ru/ thog mar 'chun bcas sbyor ba drug ldan bca' bar bya/ /bzhi btsugs hag ces brjod pa stag mo'i skyug stangs yin/ /de dang 'dra la hing zhes gcu ba glang po'i 'gying*/ pus btsugs stong 'then hūṃ zhes wa ya bsnom du bshad/ /sgril dang sna sdems seng ge rnam rol spyi dang 'dra/ /g.yas g.yon dpung bcag sprugs pa g.yang mo'i khong sprugs te/ /hig 'dren langs dang tsog pu yi dwags pre ta ka/ khu tshur brlar bzhag dgang 'then sprugs pa 'dren chung zer/ /gyen bzlog i zhes khong 'dren ha bcas bar ma yin/ /huṃ 'dren drag po rkang gshog 'then pa 'dren chen te/ /langs mnan brkyang bskum 'phar zhing brdung ba 'phar g.yor grags/ /gyen bzlog bzhi sprugs g.yas g.yon 'then res phur 'don no/ /phyi gan pus brang re mos brkyang bskum rab brkyang ste/ /pho ba btsugs nas gling bzhi brkyang bskum seng ge'i rtsal/ /rkang dpung bsnol mar 'jus nas gcud par gcud 'then yin/ /thal sbyar mgo mgrin stod smad gcud pa gsum 'grems so/ /rkang btsugs khu tshur dpung sbyar mgo brdung seng ge'i 'gyeng*/ skyil krung pus 'khyud dpung 'then gnon pa rma bya'i 'gyur/

/langs dang 'dug nas dgang gtod 'dren pa sbags 'dren te/ /rlung gnyis dbye bsdud langs dang 'dug tshul yongs 'dzin yin/ /de ltar na nyi shu po de rnams rjes dran gyi yan lag tu dgos pa'i 'khrul 'khor rnams so/ /shin tu zab cing ngo mtshar ba/ /yan lag drug pa'i gdams ngag las/ lus sbyong rnam pa sna tshogs dag /brgyud pa tha dad las byung ba/ /mang po rnams las nyer mkho ni/ /zab bsdus byas pa 'di tsam yin/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug bi ru pa'i/ gdams ngag 'chi med grub pa yang*/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyu rgyal la/ /brten nas mdzad pa yin zhes gsungs/ /gzhan yang 'di dang mthun pa yi/ /gdams ngag rnam pa mang po mthong*/ /'di bris pa yi dge bas kyang*/ / mkha' mnyam sems can ma lus pa/ /'gyur ba med pa'i gnas thob nas/ / 'phrin las rgyun mi chad par shog/ //sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i man ngag rnying po'i 'khrul 'khor gyi sdom 'di yang*/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/sbyaur ba yan lag drug pa'i man ngag snying po'i 'khrul 'khor gyi sdoms bzhugs/ -PAGE 390--PAGE 391--PAGE 389-
